LESSON: LENGTH

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: MEASUREMENT Strand Sub strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learning Expe
Topic 2.1: Length
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 6

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Length, part of MEASUREMENT Strand Sub strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learning Expe in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How is the length of an object measured?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. Use sticks of equal length in purposive pairs/groups to measure lengths of different objects and record the measurements, learners are appropriately positioned/ seated on devices whose worktops/ table tops are at a suitable height and guided to use sticks (padded at points of grip)

2. Use sticks of different lengths to measure length, including a 1- metre sticks, by the use of any functional part of the body and/ appropriate Assistive technology for manipulation and mobility and with physical support.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. Use sticks of equal length in purposive pairs/groups to measure lengths of different objects and record the measurements, learners are appropriately positioned/ seated on devices whose worktops/ table tops are at a suitable height and guided to use sticks (padded at points of grip)
2. Use sticks of different lengths to measure length, including a 1- metre sticks, by the use of any functional part of the body and/ appropriate Assistive technology for manipulation and mobility and with physical support.
3. In purposive teams, use locally available materials to make 1-metre sticks and use

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Length together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking and problem solving: learner makes 1-metre sticks and uses them in measuring length of various objects.

• Self-efficacy: learner measures the length of different objects at home, records the measurements and discusses with peers in

school.

Values:
• Responsibility: learner uses locally available materials to make 1-metre sticks and use them to measure the length of various

objects.

• Unity: learner works in teams to make 1-metre sticks and use them to measure the length of various objects.

• Self-esteem: learner measures the length of different objects at home, record the measurements and discuss with peers in

school.

• Creative thinking: learner uses locally available materials to make 1-metre stick.

Link to Other Learning Areas:

The learner is able to relate the concept of using objects within the classroom and at home for learning to the concept of

resources in the environment in Environmental Activities.
